sources.finding: Scheduled/manual/one-shot tasks run on one owning machine (CLI, local timezone; nothing runs in cloud); agent can only propose schedules, never create them; missed runs catch up once; only the creator can edit/pause/delete; machine must be awake.

sources.title: GitHub Integration | Lody
sources.locator: GitHub App setup, issue/PR context, PR panel, auto-archive, commit/push, review sync
sources.finding: GitHub App gives repo access; issues/PRs inject context via @; PR panel shows state/CI/comments/reviews with in-Lody merge and branch delete; review comments sync both ways; PR-linked sessions auto-archive on merge/close; optional act-as-you identity for PR actions.

sources.title: Worktrees | Lody
sources.locator: Worktree layout, setup/cleanup scripts, env vars, retention and recovery
sources.finding: One branch (session/<id>) and worktree per session under ~/.lody/repos/<repoId>/; project setup/cleanup scripts with LODY_* env vars; archive/backup rules keep branches and stage pending changes, discard ignored files; restore recreates the worktree from the branch.

sources.title: End-to-End Encrypted Workspaces | Lody
sources.locator: Standard vs encrypted comparison, device approval, recovery, known limits
sources.finding: In E2E workspaces only authorized devices can read content; servers relay/store unreadable data; new devices need approval; loss of all devices plus recovery file means permanent loss; browser security depends on served code; price page flags E2E as coming soon on Plus.

sources.title: Permission Ledger | Lody
sources.locator: Signed records, hash chain, member/device authorization
sources.finding: Permission ledger holds signed membership/device records in a hash chain that devices verify; the server cannot quietly add members; execution grants are memory-only and checked against current membership.

sources.title: Agent Roles | Lody
sources.locator: Role creation, sharing, mentions, offline-machine behavior
sources.finding: Roles package machine, agent config, model, reasoning, permission and instruction; private until shared with workspace; mentionable via @ to start new conversations; bound to one machine/config and unusable while offline.

sources.title: Lody Review | Lody
sources.locator: Review format, report contents, requirements, options
sources.finding: npx lody review renders a local Git review into a self-contained shareable HTML report without signing in; runs read-only against the local repo; first render may download and cache a verified viewer.

sources.title: Connect Magpie | Lody
sources.locator: Import targets, gateway, statuses, model management
sources.finding: One command imports Magpie provider setups (Claude, Codex, Pi, DSH, Kimi, Grok, Bub) on the same server; upstream API keys stay in Magpie; import does not prove inference works; cloud workspaces only, not OSS local-only mode.

sources.title: CLI Runtime Types | Lody
sources.locator: ACP Registry runtimes, Custom ACP, prerequisites note
sources.finding: Every ACP Registry runtime (Auggie, Autohand, Codebuddy, Cline, Factory, Gemini, Kimi, OpenCode, Qwen, pi ACP) plus Custom ACP launch commands; host must have the runtime command, login and credentials installed; models depend on runtime and account.

sources.title: ACP and Extension Feature Support | Lody
sources.locator: Support matrix, extension capability reference, notes
sources.finding: Nine built-in providers (Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Kimi Code, Devin, Pi, DeepSeek Harness, Bub, Dimcode) share the ACP baseline; optional capabilities (MCP transports, resume/fork, steering, tasks, subagents, goals, usage, rate limits) differ per adapter via acp-extension-core; declarations are read at session start so updates can shift the matrix.

sources.title: Coming from Codex or Claude Code | Lody
sources.locator: What stays the same, concept mapping, migration checklist, FAQ
sources.finding: Lody launches the same provider CLIs and reuses machine-side subscription logins, API env config, and repo instruction files (AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md); sessions resume like --resume; CLI remains supported for quick one-off edits.

sources.title: Concepts & Glossary | Lody
sources.locator: Mental model, core objects, Agent Config vs Role, MCP/daemon/permission scope glossary
sources.finding: Workspace holds members, machines, sessions and settings; session = one task/conversation/branch; Agent Config = runtime plus auth and machine; Lody exposes built-in MCP tools for cross-session work; daemon is the background CLI that runs agents.

sources.title: Local Projects | Lody
sources.locator: Adding projects, local-first availability, CLI history sync, team visibility, limitations
sources.finding: Any local directory works with synced chat/diffs/branches/worktrees; desktop works offline with later sync; imports Codex/Claude CLI history; team visibility is opt-in per project; local projects cannot push to remote branches directly.

sources.title: Diff Viewer | Lody
sources.locator: Round diffs, line comments, whole-conversation changes, remote review
sources.finding: Per-round diffs with changed line counts beside the agent message; file/diff tabs; whole-conversation Changes sidebar; remote devices read diffs through the session file provider with explicit loading states.

sources.title: Diff Comments | Lody
sources.locator: Threads, resolve, send-to-agent, GitHub sync
sources.finding: Line-level Markdown threads with reply/edit/delete/resolve; threads can be sent into the chat for the agent to address; PR-linked sessions sync both ways with GitHub PR review comments.

sources.title: Recommended Workflow | Lody
sources.locator: Small tasks, parallel sessions, AI review loop, archiving
sources.finding: One conversation per feature/fix (usually one PR); review round diffs; Create PR from the session; AI review loop on PR comments; archive (or auto-archive) when merged; non-GitHub projects skip PR/CI automation.

sources.title: Your First Session | Lody
sources.locator: Walkthrough, stop control, archive, FAQ (no GitHub needed)
sources.finding: First session works on a plain local directory without GitHub; stop control cancels the active turn; archived sessions keep branch and conversation and are restorable.

sources.title: Lody README (release v0.109.0)
sources.locator: Share conversations, bring agents/machines, daemon, CLI, agent coordination, E2E, mobile credit
sources.finding: Shared workspace for coding agents teams already use; daemon connects machines; CLI manages sessions; agents coordinate via session tools; parallel worktrees and live diff review; local-first direction via Loro/Flock; mobile clients native with upstream credit.

sources.title: Privacy Policy (LoroHub LLC)
sources.locator: Data collected, subprocessors, retention/deletion, rights
sources.finding: Controller LoroHub LLC; collects account/auth data, device/diagnostics, service logs, conversation content; subprocessors Cloudflare, Convex, GitHub, Google Analytics, PostHog, Sentry; export/deletion on request with 30-day clearance; no explicit model-training use stated; no telemetry opt-out control documented.

sources.title: Terms of Service (LoroHub LLC)
sources.locator: Provider, sign-in, fees/billing, account rules
sources.finding: Provider LoroHub LLC; sign-in via GitHub OAuth; free and paid (Plus) plans with prices on the pricing page in USD; user retains content ownership with a services-only license grant.

sources.title: Support | Lody
sources.locator: Contact channels, response expectation, bug-report guidance
sources.finding: Support via email, Discord and X (@lody_ai); responds typically within a couple of business days; no response-time commitment; bug reports should include platform and repro steps.

sources.title: Changelog | Lody
sources.locator: Dated release notes entries
sources.finding: Dated bilingual release notes with recent entries (e.g. 2026-10-15 desktop sign-in fixes; 2026-04-22 PR panel); documents active maintenance alongside GitHub releases.

sources.finding: New native iOS and Android clients under active development with independent build toolchains; iOS built directly on Innei lody-ios with provenance-tracked runtime snapshot reused on Android; mobile client code landed after pinned release v0.109.0.

sources.finding: CLI implements session/machine/daemon/agent-config/GitHub/review/export/magpie commands; no public REST API surface or SDK package in commands, packages or docs.

sources.title: apps/cli/src/mcp at v0.109.0
sources.locator: lody-mcp-server.ts (@modelcontextprotocol/server), lody-mcp-http-server.ts, session-mcp-resolver.ts, schedule-tools.ts, agent-role-tools.ts, authentication/

sources.title: commands/internal.ts at v0.109.0
sources.locator: lody-mcp-server / lody-mcp-http-host command definitions

sources.locator: schedule-command-service, schedule-documents; pr-poller/ for PR polling
sources.finding: Schedule storage and command service live in the CLI on the owning machine; PR state arrives via polling (pr-poller/), and no webhook receiver exists in apps/cli, packages or docs.

sources.title: commands/session.ts worktree paths at v0.109.0
sources.locator: worktree creation/session worktree references; agent-client worktree handling
sources.finding: Sessions create and manage per-session Git worktrees/branches; container, VM, gVisor, Firecracker and OS-sandbox isolation terms return no implementation hits (only file-icon assets), so isolation is worktree-level file separation.

sources.title: agent-client.ts permission paths at v0.109.0
sources.locator: permissionMode/permission plumbing; lody-acp-extension steering/rate-limit snapshots
sources.finding: Per-session permission modes flow into agent runs with steering support and rate-limit snapshots where the adapter declares them; personal/project credential grants stay machine-local.

sources.title: commands/export.ts at v0.109.0
sources.locator: exportWorkspaceData, --json, offline support
sources.finding: lody export writes workspace data (sessions, images optional) with --json and offline support; account/data deletion is an email request flow per site-docs account-deletion page.

sources.title: notifications AGENTS.md at v0.109.0
sources.locator: Turn/outcome notification pipeline, mobile/cloud ports, best-effort delivery
sources.finding: Turn outcomes project into control documents and mobile push via the cloud port with best-effort delivery (no outbox, retry, reconnect replay or exactly-once); permission push and Live Activity sync are separate paths.

sources.title: orchestration README at v0.109.0
sources.locator: Coordinator workflow, inbox, session-create rollback point-of-no-return
sources.finding: Orchestration layer runs coordinator workflows over sessions with an inbox; session-create has a documented point-of-no-rollback for cleanup only (not user-facing revert); no merge queue, batch-review queue or duplicate-task detection.

sources.title: apps/cli README encrypted-execution section at v0.109.0
sources.locator: authorizeExecution, owner/admin/member device grants, journal reset
sources.finding: Encrypted workspaces authorize execution per workspace/device with owner/admin/member grants, sub-15-minute memory-only grants, and offline journal reset; UI account IDs grant nothing; guest/recovery/removed/revoked devices do not qualify.
